Trumpworld is wildly unimpressed with the administration's handling of the
Jeffrey Epstein files, with many in the MAGA and GOP elite flabbergasted at
how Donald Trump's [Justice Department](https://zeteo.com/p/team-trump-plans-
to-keep-ratfcking) keeps pathetically bungling its [own cover-
up](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-epstein-files-cover-up-released-documents-
clinton).

"They keep making it look like we have something to hide," a White House
official complains to **Zeteo**.

On Tuesday, **Zeteo** contacted numerous Trump advisers, senior administration
officials, Republican lawmakers, right-wing media figures, and other close
allies of the president asking them to grade how the Justice Department (which
acts as [an extension of President Trump's corrupt
wishes](https://zeteo.com/p/thank-god-for-dumb-susie-wiles-say)) has handled
the Epstein saga, particularly [from
July](https://www.rollingstone.com/politics/politics-features/epstein-memo-
justice-department-maga-1235380042/) to the present.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe?)

All but one of the dozen-plus Trumpland denizens (who were granted anonymity
to speak freely) responded with an "F" or "F-minus." And one respondent was
even harsher: "F-minus-minus."
